blurb: The Centre offers ballet and dance classes for various ages and levels, including a professional Academy program. They provide summer dance experiences, performance opportunities like The Nutcracker, and support for families through the Parent Circle. Classes and programs are held at multiple locations including Virginia-Highland Centre.
extraNote: Registration fees and tuition for summer programs are non-refundable; withdrawals before June 1, 2026 receive account credit, no credits after · Schedule change requests after October 1 incur a $25 fee except for certain exceptions · Participation fee for The Nutcracker is $175; no audition fee · Virginia-Highland Centre, 504 Amsterdam Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30306
